meta.description:
Welcome to the Official YouTube Channel for Hey Duggee!
 
Duggee is a big friendly dog who runs The Squirrel Club - a place where kids take part in all kinds of activities, have adventures & earn activity badges along the way.
 
Get set for laughter, learning and exciting activities.

Watch all Hey Duggee full episodes on BBC iPlayer: https://bbc.in/3V0dLBC

Hey Duggee has arrived in the US! Watch
